issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 05 requires the average (durchschnittliche) area of municipalities per district (kreis) along with the district name and Regierungsbezirk. The provided solution computes COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche), which contradicts the specification and would produce fundamentally different results. This discrepancy between the problem description and the solution will confuse students about the intended aggregation (average vs. count).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution to use AVG(flaeche) instead of COUNT(flaeche) and ensure the selected columns match the task (include regierungsbezirk and kreis). For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis. Also update the template file to show an appropriate starter (e.g. a commented hint) so students are guided to use AVG.
